measures.name: contribution cur
measures.expression: [sum deg cur rev]/[sum total cur rev]

measures.name: contribution past
measures.expression: [sum deg past rev]/[sum total past rev]

measures.name: IND QTY PER TRANS DEEP DIVE
measures.expression: SWITCH(TRUE(),[QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] >0, UNICHAR(11165), [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] <0,UNICHAR(11167),[QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] = 0,UNICHAR(9899))

measures.name: ShowButton_CF022_v1
measures.expression:
VAR AllStores = ALL( MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[store_no] )
RETURN
IF(
    COUNTROWS( FILTER( AllStores, [store_no] = "CFH022" ) ) > 0,
    1,
    0
)

measures.name: CF022_AccessText
measures.expression:
IF (
    [ShowButton_CF022_v1] = 1,
    "CLICK TO SEE NEW LOC DATA",
    ""
)

measures.name: IND RETAIL PRICE DEEP DIVE
measures.expression: SWITCH(TRUE(),[RETAIL PRICE GROWTH] >0, UNICHAR(11165), [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH] <0,UNICHAR(11167),[RETAIL PRICE GROWTH] = 0,UNICHAR(9899))

measures.name: QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH
measures.expression: [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR]-[QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR]

measures.name: SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH
measures.expression: [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR]-[SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR]

measures.name: IND SPEND PER TRANS DEEP DIVE
measures.expression: SWITCH(TRUE(),[SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] >0, UNICHAR(11165), [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] <0,UNICHAR(11167),[SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] = 0,UNICHAR(9899))

measures.name: RETAIL PRICE GROWTH
measures.expression: [retail price current year]-[retail price past year]

measures.name: IND SPEND PER TRANS DEEP DIVE NEW
measures.expression:
SWITCH (
    TRUE(),
    [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] > 0, UNICHAR(9632),  -- Square
    [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] < 0, UNICHAR(9632),  -- Same square, will color differently
    [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] = 0, ""
)
